title: Hearts: inadequate identity & access management
description: A Jenkins controller uses its own user database with no protection against password guessing, and its privileged agents administrator, knave, has a weak password. Starting from a low-privileged account, brute-force knave's password and use its access to read the System-scope prod-deploy credential (OWASP CICD-SEC-2, Inadequate Identity and Access Management).
question: Submit the secret of the System-scope prod-deploy credential, read after brute-forcing the knave account, exactly as recovered.
